unit_endpoint.name: task_success
unit_endpoint.definition: One only when the preregistered task answer and all task-critical constraints are exactly satisfied; otherwise zero.

required_fields.prediction_consistency: mean(clean_parse_ok and perturbed_parse_ok and canonical_clean_prediction == canonical_perturbed_prediction); any parse failure scores inconsistent
required_fields.worst_perturbation_tsr: minimum task-success rate over preregistered perturbation families

interpretation.clean_task_success_rate: Clean-task capability; required context for every robustness claim.
interpretation.conditional_retention: Primary robustness endpoint; must never be shown without clean and perturbed TSR.
interpretation.regression_rate: Equivalent lower-is-better form of one minus conditional retention.
interpretation.robustness_drop_pp: Diagnostic because clean-wrong to perturbed-correct improvements can offset regressions.
interpretation.prediction_consistency: Diagnostic only because an always-wrong model can be perfectly consistent.
